summary: Distribute the host contract to adopters

delivery.outcome: Every adopter receives the host instruction files and the fail-closed hook as digest-pinned managed files, so GOV-SYNC-001 protects them exactly as it protects AGENTS.md, and the installer can activate a checkout without copying a file over itself.
nonGoals: Adding the governance / enforce CI job; that is the next dependent slice.
Upgrading any adopter; adoption stays an explicit per-repository transaction.
Adding the Copilot host, which does not fit this slice's file budget.

architecture.decision: Ship the host files through the package manifest that already carries AGENTS.md, so distribution and digest pinning reuse one mechanism. Drive the installer from the contract and the manifest instead of a hardcoded file list, and make an in-place activation distinct from a bootstrap into a different checkout.
interfaceChanges: adopters receive CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, the Cursor rule, .aider.conf.yml and .githooks/pre-commit as managed files
install-agent-hosts.sh gains --check and in-place activation, and reads its file list from the contract
the aider host joins the contract
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch. Adopters keep their current managed digests until they run an explicit standard upgrade, so no adopter changes on merge alone.

validation.evidence: Bootstrap into a fresh clone delivers every declared host file and the contract, and sets core.hooksPath.
Adoption resolves every new package source and locks its digest.
In-place activation reports an already-active checkout instead of failing on cp of a file onto itself.
